jobs.title: Director, Business Intelligence
jobs.description:
At Viral Nation,
we specialize in building social-first ecosystems for brands to connect with the modern consumer journey. Our integrated solutions align strategy, talent, media, and technology with culturally relevant creativity to scale the world’s fastest-growing digital brands. Viral Nation offers a fluid, creative, and growth-oriented environment that will support your ambitions to apply your talents in an open, collaborative, and fast-paced culture. Our ability to stay at the forefront of the industry has fuelled our success and will guide us in paving the path forward. We’re driven to push boundaries and think beyond today to deliver strategies, and we’re just getting started.

While we continuously exceed our goals, we need your help – our success is only as great as our people. Strong performance leads to high expectations, and we must keep raising the bar!

The Director, Business Intelligence will lead enterprise-wide analytics strategy and will be responsible for building and leading a high-performing team of analysts delivering actionable insights across sales forecasting, retail performance, campaign measurement, and influencer/paid/social strategy optimization.

This leader will serve as a strategic thought partner to Sales, Marketing, Brand, eCommerce, Finance, and Executive Leadership, translating data into commercial growth opportunities, driving ROI, and embedding analytics into core business decision-making. The role combines strategic vision, technical depth, cross-functional leadership, and team development.

Responsibilities:

Act as a senior analytics partner to client account, strategy, and service teams by translating client objectives into scalable, best-in-class measurement frameworks that support social-first marketing performance.
Serve as the senior analytics advisor to executive leadership, shaping marketing, retail, and social investment decisions through data-driven insights.
Elevate analytics from reporting to strategic advantage by synthesizing data into clear narratives that inform brand positioning, channel strategy, and enterprise decision-making.
Own end-to-end measurement strategy across paid media, influencer, social, and retail media, ensuring clear linkage between investment and revenue outcomes.
Forecast and quantify incremental revenue and retail lift across eCommerce and offline retail partners by developing predictive models that connect media spend, influencer engagement, and social performance to sales velocity and conversion.
Design and operationalize robust ROI frameworks, including brand lift studies, sales lift studies, incrementality testing, multi-touch attribution, and marketing mix modeling, translating insights into optimized channel mix and budget allocation.
Build scalable measurement systems to evaluate influencer effectiveness, content performance, audience growth, and conversion impact, informing creative strategy and platform optimization.
Identify emerging consumer and digital engagement trends to inform brand strategy, innovation, and go-to-market planning.
Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing analytics team, fostering a culture of analytical rigor, commercial acumen, and executive-ready storytelling.
Design and oversee scalable data collection and reporting infrastructure, including structured databases, automated reporting workflows, dashboards, and standardized presentations.

Qualifications:

Extensive experience in marketing, media, or agency environments, with demonstrated ability to apply analytics and research to drive client strategy and business outcomes.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (Social Sciences, Statistics, Data Science, Business Analytics, or related discipline), or equivalent practical experience.
12+ years of progressive experience in research, analytics, and measurement, with a proven track record of leading complex, high-impact initiatives.
Advanced expertise in primary and secondary research methodologies, including brand tracking, brand and communications strategy, brand lift studies, regression analysis, Market Mix Modeling, social listening, and digital and site analytics.
Deep technical proficiency in analytics and BI technologies, including Python and SQL for analysis and data modeling, Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, and Snowflake for data infrastructure, and BI tools such as Sigma or comparable platforms for scalable reporting and dashboarding.
Demonstrated ability to architect and optimize analytics workflows, data pipelines, and reporting systems that support automation, scalability, and self-serve insights.
Strong executive-level communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior client stakeholders, providing strategic guidance grounded in data, research rigor, and business context.

This role has an annual salary range of $140,000 - $160,000.

This range reflects the full scope and progression of the role, from building capability to operating with sustained impact at a higher level. In addition to base salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits and total rewards package designed to support our team as they grow with us.

Where an offer falls within this range is determined through the interview process. Candidates are benchmarked by the hiring team based on role scope, relevant experience, skill alignment, and expected impact, using consistent and objective criteria.

Compensation Philosophy:

At Viral Nation, compensation is structured, performance-led, and market-aligned. Pay decisions are intentional, based on role requirements, performance, and market alignment by country, and are set to maintain internal pay equity across comparable roles and levels.

Compensation progression is tied to demonstrated performance, expanded scope, and sustained contribution over time, not tenure alone. Employee compensation is reviewed regularly through formal performance reviews and check-ins to ensure alignment with role expectations and impact.

AI in Recruitment:

Viral Nation does not use AI-enabled tools to screen, assess, rank, or select candidates – our hiring teams make all hiring decisions. AI note-taking tools may be used during interviews.

DEI Commitment:

Viral Nation is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in our agency. Viral Nation welcomes applications from people with visible and non-visible disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruiting and selection process.

jobs.title: VP Product — Software Platform / VP Produit — Plateforme Logicielle
jobs.description:
La version française suit

Company Description

Headquartered in Montreal, Detroit and Munich, Vention helps manufacturers automate their operations in record time with the only hardware and software AI-powered platform built for the factory floor. Our technology powers over 25,000 machines across 4,000 factories across 5 continents and we have the privilege to work with a significant proportion of Fortune 500 manufacturers, from space rockets, to electrical cars, to robotics.

At Vention, you’ll work alongside driven and talented people who care deeply about their craft and the impact they create. We’re a team of high achievers who grow through meaningful work, solving complex challenges, learning fast, and seeing the results of our efforts every day.

We move quickly and aim high, but we do it together with care, collaboration, and respect. Our culture celebrates diverse perspectives and supports your growth through intentional development, strong leadership, and opportunities to make a real difference.

What You’ll Do

This is not a traditional SaaS product leadership role.

Vention's software platform sits at the intersection of industrial automation, robotics, developer tools, cloud software, embedded systems and Physical AI. Our products are tightly interconnected, with decisions in one part of the stack often creating significant implications elsewhere.

The VP Product will lead a team of Product Managers and UI/UX Designers across a broad portfolio including:

MachineBuilder — 3D machine design and configuration
MachineLogic — Robot programming and automation development
Simulation — machine and robot simulation
Robot Control — real-time control and orchestration
Physical AI — AI-powered automation capabilities
Web & eCommerce — digital purchasing and configuration experience
RemoteSupport & RemoteView — remote machine support and operation
MachineAnalytics — machine data, monitoring and intelligence

The mandate is simple: make Vention's software dramatically better while dramatically increasing the velocity at which we ship it.

You will bring product rigor and leadership to an organization where the CEO and CTO remain deeply involved in product direction. Your role is therefore not to simply "own the roadmap." It is to become the operating engine that translates strategic direction into an exceptional product vision, clear priorities and fast execution.

Set the Product Vision & Experience
Define the long-term product vision across Vention's entire software platform.
Establish a coherent product strategy spanning design, programming, simulation, robotics, AI, eCommerce and machine operations.
Raise the bar for simplicity, usability and design quality across the platform, with an Apple-like obsession for product excellence.
Establish product principles and UX standards that make a highly sophisticated technology stack feel simple and intuitive.
Translate company-level strategic direction into a clear, differentiated product vision and roadmap.
Drive Product Velocity & Execution
Dramatically accelerate the pace at which Vention turns ideas into shipped products.
Establish a high-performance product operating cadence focused on fast decisions, clear accountability and measurable outcomes.
Ruthlessly prioritize initiatives based on customer impact, strategic value and business outcomes.
Remove organizational and process bottlenecks that slow product development.
Build a culture where Product, Engineering and Design are accountable for shipping—not simply planning.
Orchestrate the Platform Roadmap
Own prioritization across a highly integrated portfolio of software, firmware, robotics and Physical AI products.
Manage dependencies and sequencing across MachineBuilder, MachineLogic, simulation, robot control, firmware, analytics, RemoteView, RemoteSupport and eCommerce.
Balance customer-facing features, foundational technology investments, technical debt and emerging opportunities.
Resolve competing priorities across product teams and make difficult trade-offs quickly.
Ensure individual product roadmaps collectively move the Vention platform forward as one integrated system.
Lead Product, Design & Technical Product Management
Lead, develop and scale a high-performing organization of Product Managers and UI/UX Designers.
Raise the technical depth, product judgment and execution standards of the product organization.
Partner closely with Engineering to make sound architectural and product trade-offs.
Stay sufficiently technical to dive into architecture, APIs, code and system design when required.
Develop product leaders who can operate independently while maintaining alignment with Vention's overall product strategy.

What You Bring To The Table

Exceptional product leader with 12+ years of experience in product, software or technology leadership, including significant experience managing multiple product teams.
Deep technical credibility with the ability to understand software architecture, APIs, distributed systems, embedded systems and technical trade-offs—and to go into the code when necessary.
Broad platform experience managing complex, highly integrated products where decisions and dependencies span multiple teams and technology layers.
Outstanding product taste with an instinct for simplicity, elegance, consistency and intuitive user experiences; a genuine obsession with design quality and product perfection.
Proven execution track record with a bias toward action, demonstrated ability to accelerate roadmaps, make decisions quickly and consistently turn strategy into shipped products.
Exceptional prioritization skills with the ability to make difficult trade-offs across competing customer needs, technical investments, product opportunities and business priorities.
Strong systems thinker who can understand how individual products, technologies and teams fit together into a coherent platform and architecture.
Customer- and business-oriented with the ability to balance customer value, strategic differentiation, revenue impact and long-term platform investments.
Strong people leader who can attract, develop and inspire exceptional Product Managers and UI/UX Designers while raising the overall bar for product talent and accountability.
Comfortable operating in a highly engaged leadership environment, able to partner effectively with the CEO, CTO and other leaders while bringing structure, clarity and independent judgment to product execution.
Passion for robotics, AI and industrial technology, with genuine curiosity about how software, robotics, Physical AI and hardware can converge to transform automation.
High ownership and low ego: intellectually rigorous, direct, pragmatic and willing to dive into the details when required to solve a problem.

What We Offer

Career pathing: Real opportunities to grow through personalized development plans, bi-annual employee reviews, and mentorship program
Professional development: Continuous training in performance management, inclusive leadership, leadership operating model, team building, and giving/receiving feedback
Gender diversity & inclusion: Pay equity reviews, inclusive policies, and a Women’s Employee Resource Group offering networking, mentorship, and quarterly learning sessions.
Hybrid work: Enjoy flexibility with our hybrid model, allowing you to work from home on select days.
Community engagement: Two paid volunteering days per year to give back to causes you care about.
Team events: All year round employee events including annual kick-off, employee summit, quarterly happy hours, and department events.
Comprehensive benefits: A complete group benefits plan for you and your family that start day one.
Top-up and benefits for new parents: Additional financial support and resources to support employees during their transition to parenthood.

What To Expect In Your Interview

Initial Call
Meet the Team
Case or take-home interview
Decision & Offer

We’re committed to making every step of the process inclusive and accessible. If you require accommodations at any stage, please let us know, we’ll ensure you have what you need to succeed.

Vention’s culture

Vention is an uplifting environment for high achievers. Thinking that Vention’s culture would keep you energized? See our full culture guide here

Demo Day 2025

Culture Video

Description De L’entreprise

Basée à Montréal, Detroit et Munich, Vention aide les fabricants à automatiser leurs opérations en un temps record grâce à la seule plateforme matérielle et logicielle alimentée par l’IA conçue pour l’usine. Notre technologie alimente plus de 25 000 machines dans 4 000 usines réparties sur 5 continents, et nous avons le privilège de collaborer avec une grande proportion des fabricants du Fortune 500, allant de la construction de fusées à l’automobile électrique, en passant par la robotique.

Chez Vention, vous travaillerez aux côtés de personnes passionnées et talentueuses qui ont à cœur leur métier et l’impact qu’elles créent. Nous formons une équipe de personnes ambitieuses qui évoluent grâce à un travail porteur de sens, en relevant des défis complexes, en apprenant rapidement et en constatant chaque jour les résultats de leurs efforts.

Nous avançons vite et visons haut, mais nous le faisons ensemble, avec soin, collaboration et respect. Notre culture valorise la diversité des perspectives et soutient votre développement grâce à un encadrement intentionnel, un leadership fort et des occasions concrètes de faire une réelle différence.

Ce Que Vous Ferez

Il ne s'agit pas d'un rôle de leadership de produit SaaS traditionnel.

La plateforme logicielle de Vention se situe à l'intersection de l'automatisation industrielle, de la robotique, des outils pour développeurs, des logiciels infonuagiques, des systèmes embarqués et de l'IA physique (Physical AI). Nos produits sont étroitement interconnectés, et les décisions prises dans une partie de l'architecture technologique (stack) ont souvent des implications importantes ailleurs.

Le Ou La VP Produit Dirigera Une Équipe De Gestionnaires De Produits Et De Designers UI/UX à Travers Un Vaste Portefeuille Comprenant

MachineBuilder — Conception de machines en 3D et configuration
MachineLogic — Programmation de robots et développement de l'automatisation
Simulation — Simulation de machines et de robots
Robot Control (Contrôle de robots) — Contrôle et orchestration en temps réel
Physical AI (IA Physique) — Capacités d'automatisation propulsées par l'IA
Web & eCommerce (Commerce électronique) — Expérience numérique d'achat et de configuration
RemoteSupport & RemoteView — Soutien et exploitation de machines à distance
MachineAnalytics — Données de machines, surveillance et intelligence

Le mandat est simple : rendre les logiciels de Vention considérablement meilleurs, tout en augmentant de façon draconienne la vitesse à laquelle nous les livrons (ship).

Vous apporterez de la rigueur et du leadership en matière de produit au sein d'une organisation où le PDG (CEO) et le Chef de la technologie (CTO) restent profondément impliqués dans l'orientation du produit. Votre rôle ne consistera donc pas simplement à « posséder la feuille de route » (roadmap). Il s'agira de devenir le moteur opérationnel qui traduit l'orientation stratégique en une vision de produit exceptionnelle, avec des priorités claires et une exécution rapide.

Définir la vision et l'expérience produit
Définir la vision produit à long terme pour l'ensemble de la plateforme logicielle de Vention.
Établir une stratégie de produit cohérente couvrant la conception, la programmation, la simulation, la robotique, l'IA, le commerce électronique et les opérations des machines.
Rehausser la barre en matière de simplicité, de convivialité et de qualité de conception sur l'ensemble de la plateforme, avec une obsession de l'excellence produit digne d'Apple.
Établir des principes de produit et des normes d'expérience utilisateur (UX) qui rendent une architecture technologique haut

jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
BoomerangFX

Location:
Mississauga, Ontario — on-site, five days per week
Reports to:
Chief Executive Officer

Mandatory Experience

A Canadian CPA designation and hands-on experience leading finance and operations for a PE-backed SaaS company scaling ARR from $5 million to $50 million.

Why Join BoomerangFX?

BoomerangFX is a global healthcare technology company bringing SaaS, artificial intelligence and digital marketing together to help private-pay healthcare practices operate and grow. Recognized through Deloitte’s Technology Fast 500 program, we are building technology that simplifies practice management, strengthens patient engagement and helps healthcare businesses reach more people.
With operations in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia and India
, we are scaling internationally and working at the forefront of AI in healthcare. Our teams collaborate across countries and disciplines to turn new ideas into products and services that make a practical difference for customers.

Joining BoomerangFX is an opportunity to build your career alongside a growing global business. You will have meaningful responsibility, exposure to international markets and the opportunity to contribute ideas, develop your skills and see the impact of your work. We welcome people who take ownership, move quickly and want to help build what comes next.

The Role

Reporting to the CEO, you will lead financial management and general operations with strong financial acumen, commercial judgment and a practical approach to execution
.

You will oversee the Controller and Accountant
while taking responsibility for talent acquisition, human resources, vendor negotiations and corporate infrastructure
. You must be comfortable reviewing the detail, challenging assumptions and resolving issues personally while building an accountable team.

Financial Leadership and Accounting Oversight

Directly oversee the Controller and Accountant, setting clear expectations for accuracy, reporting deadlines, financial controls and accountability. Review their work and provide hands-on guidance on complex issues.
Own the quality and timeliness of monthly, quarterly and annual financial reporting. Review financial statements, balance-sheet reconciliations, management reports and material accounting judgments.
Oversee billing, subscription revenue recognition, deferred revenue, collections, accounts payable, payroll and intercompany reporting. Maintain clear controls over approvals, payments and financial records.
Coordinate external accountants, auditors and tax advisers, and strengthen accounting policies and controls as the company scales.

Financial Performance and Cash Management

Lead annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, financial modelling and variance analysis. Challenge assumptions and translate financial results into clear recommendations for the CEO and department leaders.
Own a rolling 13-week cash-flow forecast and longer-term liquidity projections. Improve collections, working capital, spending discipline and visibility into financial commitments.
Analyze profitability by product, service and market. Use SaaS metrics, including ARR, retention, churn, gross margin, customer acquisition cost and payback, to evaluate performance and investment decisions.
Assess hiring plans, pricing, operating costs and major expenditures against expected returns. Drive measurable improvements in margins, productivity and progress toward sustainable profitability.

Talent Acquisition and Human Resources

Oversee talent acquisition and human resources, including internal staff and external providers. Align recruitment priorities and headcount plans with approved budgets and business needs.
Oversee recruitment execution, agency relationships, hiring timelines, onboarding and workforce planning. Hold hiring managers accountable for clear requirements, timely decisions and hiring outcomes.
Oversee HR administration, employee records, compensation and benefits coordination, performance-review processes, employee relations and offboarding, working with qualified advisers where required.

Vendor Negotiations and Corporate Infrastructure

Lead vendor negotiations and oversee procurement, contracts and renewals. Secure commercially sound pricing, payment terms and service commitments, and hold providers accountable for delivery.
Oversee corporate infrastructure, including offices, facilities, equipment, business systems and outsourced services. Ensure these resources support reliable daily operations and future growth.
Work with technology leaders on corporate IT providers, software licences, infrastructure spending and business continuity arrangements. Improve utilization and eliminate unnecessary or duplicate costs.

Operating Performance and Team Leadership

Establish operating KPIs, management dashboards and regular performance reviews across finance and the functions under your oversight.
Improve workflows, approval processes and reporting through practical automation and stronger data quality. Ensure corrective actions have accountable owners and deadlines.
Lead and develop the finance team and collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product and Technology leaders to improve execution and resource allocation.

Mandatory Qualifications

CPA designation in good standing in Canada.

At least 5-7 years of progressive finance experience, including hands-on leadership across financial reporting, controllership, budgeting, forecasting, cash management and operating performance.
At least three years of hands-on experience in a fast-paced SaaS business, including leadership of finance and operations for a PE-backed SaaS company scaling ARR from $5 million to $50 million.

Strong financial acumen and commercial judgment: the ability to interrogate financial results, build credible forecasts, evaluate SaaS unit economics and make sound decisions on costs, headcount and investment.
Proven experience directly supervising a Controller and accounting staff, reviewing their work and maintaining high standards for financial accuracy, control and delivery.
Direct experience overseeing talent acquisition, human resources, vendor negotiations and corporate infrastructure, with accountability for operational results.
Advanced financial modelling and Excel or Google Sheets skills, proficiency with accounting and reporting systems, and the ability to explain financial issues clearly to business leaders.
A record of personal ownership and effective execution in an environment with rapidly changing priorities, tight deadlines and limited resources. You must be willing to work on-site in Mississauga five days per week.

Additional Experience We Value

Measurable success improving profitability, cash generation or progress toward break-even.
Experience managing multiple entities, currencies or international operations.
Experience in healthcare technology or a business combining SaaS subscriptions and services.
Experience implementing finance systems, automating reporting or supporting transaction readiness.

Compensation and Benefits

Base salary:
CAD $135,000–$150,000 annually.
Annual target performance bonus:
50% of base salary, based on achievement of agreed performance objectives.
Total target compensation:
CAD $202,500–$225,000 annually.
Performance objectives will reflect measurable outcomes in profitability, cash management, financial reporting and operational execution.
Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage.
Paid vacation and free on-site parking.
An opportunity to work closely with the CEO and senior leadership and make a measurable contribution to a growing global healthcare technology business.

How to Apply

Submit your résumé with a brief summary of your experience in high-growth software or technology-enabled companies, including two or three measurable financial or operational results you personally delivered.
Shortlisted candidates should be prepared to discuss their experience with financial oversight, operational leadership, strategic planning, and board reporting. CPA credentials, employment experience, and professional references will be verified.

Accessibility Statement

BoomerangFX is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals and are dedicated to accommodating people with disabilities. If you require accommodation at any stage of the application process, please contact recruitment@boomerangfx.com.

jobs.title: Director, Payroll Transformation
jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 264681

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

The Director, Payroll Transformation leads the design, implementation, and modernization of enterprise payroll systems and processes across the organization. This role is accountable for delivering large-scale payroll transformation initiatives, with a focus on SAP HCM and/or SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll, ensuring system accuracy, operational continuity, and alignment across Human Resources, Technology, and Finance.

As a key leader within the transformation program, this role provides oversight and direction across all phases of payroll system delivery, including design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live stabilization. The Director will ensure payroll solutions are scalable, compliant, and aligned with enterprise standards, while supporting a seamless employee experience.

A core aspect of this role is to partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders to align business requirements with system capabilities, manage complex integrations across HRIS, finance, time, and third-party platforms, and ensure the successful execution of payroll transformation objectives.

Is this role right for you? In this role, you will:

Lead end-to-end payroll transformation initiatives, including solution design, system configuration, testing, deployment, and stabilization activities.
Drive payroll testing and validation efforts, including user acceptance testing (UAT), parallel payroll runs, reconciliation, and issue resolution to ensure system accuracy and readiness.
Oversee system integration across HR, Finance, time, and third-party platforms to enable seamless data flow and end-to-end payroll processing.
Partner with HR, Technology, Finance, and external vendors to align system requirements, manage dependencies, and deliver transformation outcomes.
Ensure compliance with regulatory, audit, and governance requirements related to payroll processing, data integrity, and financial reporting.
Lead cross-functional workstreams and collaborate with program stakeholders to ensure delivery against timelines, scope, and quality expectations.
Support continuous improvement efforts by identifying opportunities to enhance payroll processes, systems, and overall operational efficiency.
Build and maintain strong relationships across stakeholders, fostering alignment, accountability, and effective communication throughout the transformation lifecycle.
Create an environment that promotes effective and efficient operations, ensuring alignment with Scotiabank’s Values and Code of Conduct, and supporting strong governance and control practices.

Skills

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed? We’d love to work with you if you have:

Post-secondary education in Human Resources, Business, Technology, or a related field; relevant SAP or payroll certifications are considered an asset.
Progressive experience in payroll transformation, HR technology implementation, or enterprise system delivery within complex, large-scale environments.
Strong understanding of SAP HCM Payroll and/or SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll, including system configuration, testing methodologies, and payroll operations.
Demonstrated experience supporting end-to-end payroll implementation, including design, UAT, parallel runs, and post-go-live stabilization.
Experience working across HR, Technology, Finance, and vendor partners, with the ability to translate business requirements into system functionality.
Strong project and program management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver within tight timelines.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to engage senior leaders and cross-functional teams.
High attention to detail and a strong focus on accuracy, data integrity, and risk mitigation within payroll environments.
Ability to operate effectively within regulated environments, with familiarity in governance, compliance, and audit standards.
Strong leadership capability with a focus on collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Location(s): Canada : Ontario : Toronto

Scotiabank is a leading bank in the Americas. Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets.

Company Description

Headquartered in Montreal, Detroit and Munich, Vention helps manufacturers automate their operations in record time with the only hardware and software AI-powered platform built for the factory floor. Our technology powers over 25,000 machines across 4,000 factories across 5 continents and we have the privilege to work with a significant proportion of Fortune 500 manufacturers, from space rockets, to electrical cars, to robotics.

At Vention, you’ll work alongside driven and talented people who care deeply about their craft and the impact they create. We’re a team of high achievers who grow through meaningful work, solving complex challenges, learning fast, and seeing the results of our efforts every day.

We move quickly and aim high, but we do it together with care, collaboration, and respect. Our culture celebrates diverse perspectives and supports your growth through intentional development, strong leadership, and opportunities to make a real difference.

What You’ll Do

This is not a traditional SaaS product leadership role.

Vention's software platform sits at the intersection of industrial automation, robotics, developer tools, cloud software, embedded systems and Physical AI. Our products are tightly interconnected, with decisions in one part of the stack often creating significant implications elsewhere.

The VP Product will lead a team of Product Managers and UI/UX Designers across a broad portfolio including:

MachineBuilder — 3D machine design and configuration
MachineLogic — Robot programming and automation development
Simulation — machine and robot simulation
Robot Control — real-time control and orchestration
Physical AI — AI-powered automation capabilities
Web & eCommerce — digital purchasing and configuration experience
RemoteSupport & RemoteView — remote machine support and operation
MachineAnalytics — machine data, monitoring and intelligence

The mandate is simple: make Vention's software dramatically better while dramatically increasing the velocity at which we ship it.

You will bring product rigor and leadership to an organization where the CEO and CTO remain deeply involved in product direction. Your role is therefore not to simply "own the roadmap." It is to become the operating engine that translates strategic direction into an exceptional product vision, clear priorities and fast execution.

Set the Product Vision & Experience
Define the long-term product vision across Vention's entire software platform.
Establish a coherent product strategy spanning design, programming, simulation, robotics, AI, eCommerce and machine operations.
Raise the bar for simplicity, usability and design quality across the platform, with an Apple-like obsession for product excellence.
Establish product principles and UX standards that make a highly sophisticated technology stack feel simple and intuitive.
Translate company-level strategic direction into a clear, differentiated product vision and roadmap.
Drive Product Velocity & Execution
Dramatically accelerate the pace at which Vention turns ideas into shipped products.
Establish a high-performance product operating cadence focused on fast decisions, clear accountability and measurable outcomes.
Ruthlessly prioritize initiatives based on customer impact, strategic value and business outcomes.
Remove organizational and process bottlenecks that slow product development.
Build a culture where Product, Engineering and Design are accountable for shipping—not simply planning.
Orchestrate the Platform Roadmap
Own prioritization across a highly integrated portfolio of software, firmware, robotics and Physical AI products.
Manage dependencies and sequencing across MachineBuilder, MachineLogic, simulation, robot control, firmware, analytics, RemoteView, RemoteSupport and eCommerce.
Balance customer-facing features, foundational technology investments, technical debt and emerging opportunities.
Resolve competing priorities across product teams and make difficult trade-offs quickly.
Ensure individual product roadmaps collectively move the Vention platform forward as one integrated system.
Lead Product, Design & Technical Product Management
Lead, develop and scale a high-performing organization of Product Managers and UI/UX Designers.
Raise the technical depth, product judgment and execution standards of the product organization.
Partner closely with Engineering to make sound architectural and product trade-offs.
Stay sufficiently technical to dive into architecture, APIs, code and system design when required.
Develop product leaders who can operate independently while maintaining alignment with Vention's overall product strategy.

What You Bring To The Table

Exceptional product leader with 12+ years of experience in product, software or technology leadership, including significant experience managing multiple product teams.
Deep technical credibility with the ability to understand software architecture, APIs, distributed systems, embedded systems and technical trade-offs—and to go into the code when necessary.
Broad platform experience managing complex, highly integrated products where decisions and dependencies span multiple teams and technology layers.
Outstanding product taste with an instinct for simplicity, elegance, consistency and intuitive user experiences; a genuine obsession with design quality and product perfection.
Proven execution track record with a bias toward action, demonstrated ability to accelerate roadmaps, make decisions quickly and consistently turn strategy into shipped products.
Exceptional prioritization skills with the ability to make difficult trade-offs across competing customer needs, technical investments, product opportunities and business priorities.
Strong systems thinker who can understand how individual products, technologies and teams fit together into a coherent platform and architecture.
Customer- and business-oriented with the ability to balance customer value, strategic differentiation, revenue impact and long-term platform investments.
Strong people leader who can attract, develop and inspire exceptional Product Managers and UI/UX Designers while raising the overall bar for product talent and accountability.
Comfortable operating in a highly engaged leadership environment, able to partner effectively with the CEO, CTO and other leaders while bringing structure, clarity and independent judgment to product execution.
Passion for robotics, AI and industrial technology, with genuine curiosity about how software, robotics, Physical AI and hardware can converge to transform automation.
High ownership and low ego: intellectually rigorous, direct, pragmatic and willing to dive into the details when required to solve a problem.

What We Offer

Career pathing: Real opportunities to grow through personalized development plans, bi-annual employee reviews, and mentorship program
Professional development: Continuous training in performance management, inclusive leadership, leadership operating model, team building, and giving/receiving feedback
Gender diversity & inclusion: Pay equity reviews, inclusive policies, and a Women’s Employee Resource Group offering networking, mentorship, and quarterly learning sessions.
Hybrid work: Enjoy flexibility with our hybrid model, allowing you to work from home on select days.
Community engagement: Two paid volunteering days per year to give back to causes you care about.
Team events: All year round employee events including annual kick-off, employee summit, quarterly happy hours, and department events.
Comprehensive benefits: A complete group benefits plan for you and your family that start day one.

Initial Call

Basée à Montréal, Detroit et Munich, Vention aide les fabricants à automatiser leurs opérations en un temps record grâce à la seule plateforme matérielle et logicielle alimentée par l’IA conçue pour l’usine. Ce Que Vous Ferez

Il ne s'agit pas d'un rôle de leadership de produit SaaS traditionnel.

La plateforme logicielle de Vention se situe à l'intersection de l'automatisation industrielle, de la robotique, des outils pour développeurs, des logiciels infonuagiques, des systèmes embarqués et de l'IA physique (Physical AI). RemoteSupport & RemoteView — Soutien et exploitation de machines à distance
MachineAnalytics — Données de machines, surveillance et intelligence

Le mandat est simple : rendre les logiciels de Vention considérablement meilleurs, tout en augmentant de façon draconienne la vitesse à laquelle nous les livrons (ship).

Vous apporterez de la rigueur et du leadership en matière de produit au sein d'une organisation où le PDG (CEO) et le Chef de la technologie (CTO) restent profondément impliqués dans l'orientation du produit. Votre rôle ne consistera donc pas simplement à « posséder la feuille de route » (roadmap). Il s'agira de devenir le moteur opérationnel qui traduit l'orientation stratégique en une vision de produit exceptionnelle, avec des priorités claires et une exécution rapide.

Définir la vision et l'expérience produit
Définir la vision produit à long terme pour l'ensemble de la plateforme logicielle de Vention.
Établir une stratégie de produit cohérente couvrant la conception, la programmation, la simulation, la robotique, l'IA, le commerce électronique et les opérations des machines.
Rehausser la barre en matière de simplicité, de convivialité et de qualité de conception sur l'ensemble de la plateforme, avec une obsession de l'excellence produit digne d'Apple.
